```yaml
name: E2E Tests and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build project
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: pnpm run test:e2e

      - name: Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: pnpm release
```
